purpose: Extend and verify official/institutional secondary research for Sud-Vest Oltenia, Sud-Muntenia and Centru without converting project activity, training supply, administrative labour-market context or event-specific recruitment into AI4WORK need-prevalence claims.

promoted_sources.title: Bursa locurilor de munca organizata de AJOFM Mehedinti – 20.06.2025

observed_facts.event_context: ANOFM states that the event was organised following a request from an employer in Medias, Sibiu county.

promoted_sources.claim_boundary: This is a single recruitment-event snapshot linked to a concrete recruitment request. It is not representative of the county or region, does not measure competence or training need, and contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: 5,94% – rata somajului inregistrat in evidentele AJOFM Ialomita in luna decembrie 2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: Registered unemployment is administrative labour-market context, not a measurement of digital/AI competence, skill-gap prevalence or training demand. It contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Raportul de activitate AJOFM Mures pe anul 2025

observed_facts.preference_wording: The report describes computer operator and digital competences among the most popular training options expressed by unemployed persons.

promoted_sources.claim_boundary: AJOFM vacancies cover an administrative segment of the labour market. Training participation and the reported most-requested programmes reflect institutional supply and preferences among people in the agency training circuit, not representative prevalence of digital/AI need. They contribute zero H1-H5 points.

Sud-Vest Oltenia.current_complement: S49 event-specific recruitment-demand snapshot in Mehedinti, retained as counter/context evidence only

Sud-Muntenia.current_complement: S50 December 2025 registered-unemployment context in Ialomita

Centru.current_complement: S51 AJOFM Mures 2025 vacancies and training/preference administrative triangulation

forms_and_gdpr_refresh.public_surface_search_result: No dedicated AI4WORK research routes were discoverable through fresh public search; this is not represented as a live-route validation.

refresh_conclusion: The controlled Source_register and Dashboard now reconcile through S51 with one newly verified official context/triangulation row for each target region. All three additions are zero-weight for H1-H5 and do not use project activity or training supply as evidence of need. No eligible immutable real adult+employer response export exists, therefore NF06 PROD and downstream synthesis remain fail-closed.
